udt_struct_v0.doc: The treasury's `Config`, mirrored for the one field read here (same field names and\norder = same XDR map).
udt_struct_v0.name: Config

function_v0.doc: Record that `owner` operates `treasury`. Owner-signed; duplicates are a no-op.\nRefused unless the treasury's admin is `owner`.
function_v0.name: register

function_v0.doc: Drop `treasury` from `owner`'s list. Owner-signed; an absent entry is a no-op.\nNo admin check: removing a listing can only take something away from the owner.
function_v0.name: unregister

function_v0.doc: Every treasury registered by `owner`, oldest \xe2\x86\x92 newest (empty when none).
function_v0.name: treasuries_of
